_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why:
'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of
Pfizer Inc' (FY2025 10-K, Item 1); 'Certain of our products have experienced patent-based expirations or loss of regulatory exclusivity in certain markets in the last few years, and we expect certain products to face new or increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'when generic or biosimilar competition does commence, the resulting price competition can substantially decrease our revenues for the impacted products, often in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); 'Our business is conducted in intensely competitive and highly regulated markets'

classification.quality_note:
'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of
Pfizer Inc' (FY2025 10-K, Item 1); 'Certain of our products have experienced patent-based expirations or loss of regulatory exclusivity in certain markets in the last few years, and we expect certain products to face new or increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'when generic or biosimilar competition does commence, the resulting price competition can substantially decrease our revenues for the impacted products, often in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); 'Our business is conducted in intensely competitive and highly regulated markets'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.11x; +5% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.24; conservative 2yr +21%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -71.3%/yr (worst year FY17-FY25 ex-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-1.8%/yr (FY26 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.5-yr ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +-1.8%/yr (FY17-FY25 ex-FY23 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +115.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY17-FY25 ex-FY23); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2026-07-02) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.11x (95.9% downside to Bear $1 / +23.4% upside to Bull $30) | Adj composite 2.22 vs market 1.98: gap +0.24 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +5% above the EPP floor $23 (17x FY26E $1.36) | Conservative 2-yr case: +20.8% total (+10.4%/yr) | At 17.9x FY26E the 15% hurdle price $32 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues +4.3% in Q1 2026, forward revenues -4.9% to -0.1% (FY26 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
